project.name: imputemulti
project.description: Migration of the R imputeMulti package to Python/Rust
project.overview: The imputemulti package provides functionalities for multivariate multinomial data imputation using Expectation-Maximization (EM) and Data Augmentation (DA) algorithms. It uses Rust for performance-critical counting and comparison logic, exposed to Python via PyO3 bindings.

data_schemas.name: ImputeMultiResult
data_schemas.description: Represents the outcome of a full imputation process.

fields.name: imputed_data
fields.description: The final dataset with missing values filled.

api_contracts.name: count_compare_rust
api_contracts.description: Core counting logic for multinomial sufficient statistics.
raises: TypeError: If inputs are not numpy arrays
ValueError: If array dimensions or types mismatch
api_contracts.ffi_notes: Input arrays must be C-contiguous. Memory is owned by the Python caller. GIL is held during execution.

api_contracts.name: sup_dist_c_rust
api_contracts.description: Calculates the supremum distance between two vectors.
raises: ValueError: If array lengths do not match

api_contracts.name: mx_my_compare_rust
api_contracts.description: Compares rows of observed data matrix (x) to a complete pattern matrix (y) to find possible completions.
api_contracts.ffi_notes: Used for mapping observed patterns (potentially with NAs) to possible complete patterns. Output list length equals mat_x row count.

features.name: Rust Kernels for Counting and Comparison
features.description: Implementation of core performance-critical logic in Rust with PyO3 bindings.

python.rationale_if_disabled: Wrapper layer only; logic is in Rust.

acceptance_criteria: count_compare_rust returns counts matching reference values for tract2221 dataset.
sup_dist_c_rust returns correct L-infinity distance with tolerance 1e-12.
mx_my_compare_rust correctly identifies indices of Y rows contained in X rows.

test_requirements.description: Unit tests for each Rust function in src/lib.rs
Integration tests calling Rust from Python via pytest

features.name: Python Data Models and Priors
features.description: Implementation of ImputeMultiResult dataclasses and data-dependent prior calculation.
acceptance_criteria: ImputeMultiResult is immutable and validates field types.
data_dep_prior_multi produces alpha values consistent with R implementation for tract2221.

test_requirements.description: Unit tests for priors and dataclasses

features.name: EM and DA Algorithms
features.description: Implementation of Expectation-Maximization and Data Augmentation algorithms in Python, using Rust kernels.

performance_requirements.notes: K is number of multinomial levels.

acceptance_criteria: multinomial_em converges to MLE matching R output within 1e-6 tolerance.
multinomial_data_aug produces posterior draws consistent with R implementation.
multinomial_impute correctly fills NAs in a test DataFrame.

features.name: Full Documentation Migration
features.description: Full migration of R package manual to MyST markdown using Sphinx, including mathematical foundations, runnable code examples, and BibTeX citations.
acceptance_criteria: Sphinx configuration (`docs/conf.py`) includes `myst_parser` and `sphinxcontrib_bibtex` extensions.
`docs/imputemulti_manual.md` contains the full translated content from the R vignette
excluding the section on algorithm speed comparison, which is not applicable to this migration.
LaTeX math blocks (align, equations) are correctly translated and rendered via MyST.
All R code examples are replaced with functional Python equivalents using the `imputemulti` package.
Citations are managed via `docs/references.bib` and rendered in a bibliography section.
Documentation builds successfully without warnings or broken links.

test_requirements.description: Sphinx build succeeds with zero errors

features.name: Testing, Benchmarking and Validation
features.description: Full validation suite including performance benchmarks and integration tests.

performance_requirements.notes: Must produce performance report comparing to R/C++ version.

acceptance_criteria: Performance benchmarks show Rust implementation is at least 1.5x faster than R/C++ for core kernels.
Integration tests achieve > 85% code coverage.
Ruff and Mypy checks pass with no errors.

features.name: Code Coverage Configuration
features.description: Establish local coverage reporting and enforcement via pyproject.toml. Personal project scope: no external CI service required.
acceptance_criteria: pyproject.toml includes standardized coverage configuration with pytest-cov as a declared dependency.
pytest --cov enforces a fail_under threshold of 85% on every local test run.
coverage.xml is produced on every test run and is gitignored.

test_requirements.description: Coverage threshold enforced: uv run pytest exits non-zero if coverage drops below 85%

risks.description: Categorical level mapping discrepancy between R factors and Python pandas Categorical.
risks.mitigation: Enforce strict level ordering and integer encoding in utils.py; verify against R factor levels during data loading.

risks.description: Mathematical notation translation errors from LaTeX to MyST markdown syntax.
risks.mitigation: Peer review of rendered documentation against original LaTeX source; ensure Sphinx mathjax is correctly configured.

risks.description: Citation resolution failure or broken cross-references in the generated manual.
risks.mitigation: Enable Sphinx nitpicky mode and verify bibliography generation.

risks.description: Type mismatch between Rust function signature, PyO3 wrapper, and Python type hint. Three separate artefacts must agree; divergence is silent at import time and fails at runtime.
risks.mitigation: Every ffi_boundary api_contract must have an acceptance criterion that calls the function from Python with the exact expected types and asserts the exact expected output.

risks.description: mutmut and cargo-mutants operate on separate layers and cannot detect bugs that require cross-layer reasoning. A correct Python wrapper over an incorrect Rust implementation will pass all Python-layer mutation tests.
risks.mitigation: cargo-mutants must be scoped to core Rust logic. Acceptance criteria for numerical correctness must include known-answer tests with values verified independently (e.g., by a reference pure-Python implementation).

risks.description: Build step (maturin develop) not run before pytest. Tests import a stale or missing compiled extension, producing confusing ImportError or testing old behavior silently.
risks.mitigation: Actor initialization protocol always runs build.dev_install_cmd before any test invocation. CI must do the same.
